facts.summary: Early Phase 1 data: 4 of 6 CR/CRi with Flu/Ara-C lymphodepletion, small cohort, modest Flu/Cy results · Phase 1 · NKX101 in r/r AML · not yet approved
facts.indication: relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia

evidence.summary: 4 of 6 patients achieved complete response (67% CR/CRi, 50% CR rate)
evidence.safety: NKX101 was well tolerated. No dose-limiting toxicities were observed across all cohorts.
evidence.program_discontinued: Expansion cohort incorporating Ara-C based lymphodepletion expected to be the basis of NKX101 development moving forward
